LESSON: RELIGIOUS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Utsav
Topic 7.1: Religious

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Religious. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. use appropriate greetings while interacting with people during festivals
2. appreciate festivals for their role in promoting peace and friendship other about celebration of their festivals 99

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. use appropriate greetings while interacting with people during festivals
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to use appropriate greetings while interacting with people during festivals. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate festivals for their role in promoting peace and friendship other about celebration of their festivals 99
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate festivals for their role in promoting peace and friendship other about celebration of their festivals 99. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Religious.
2. Explain Religious to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Try this activity: The learners be shown pictures / videos interacting with people on the religious festivals during festivals
4. Show that you can: use appropriate greetings while interacting with people during festivals
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Religious. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Religious important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. The learners be shown pictures / videos interacting with people on the religious festivals during festivals
2. Listen and sing appropriate c) appreciate festivals for Stavans, Shabads and bhajans in groups their role in promoting related to festivals peace and friendship

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. use appropriate greetings while interacting with people during festivals
2. appreciate festivals for their role in promoting peace and friendship other about celebration of their festivals 99

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
